integrity: Symbolic proof and reproducible finite exact-rational checks are both included; the checks do not constitute an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: No mixed, coalitional, or more-than-two-action claims; exact subset count may be computationally exponential; existing partition reduction covers symmetric zero-spine limiting case; no claim of proven publication priority.
scope: Pure two-action anti-coordination on positive undirected weighted triangular-book graphs.
title: Weighted triangular-book anti-coordination: exact equilibrium census and a singular tie transition
